Stack: Ai Engineering, Llm Orchestration, Rag, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, Anthropic Claude, Openai, Deepseek, Ollama, Speech-To-Text, Text-To-Speech, Python, Fastapi, Typescript, React, Next.Js, Java, Spring, Angular, Supabase, Postgresql, Docker, Git. Latest work: Shogun (2026); Medsafe / Paciente Integrado (2026); Safebrain (2026); Qa Pipeline (Icev) (2026); Petmatch (2026).
